title: Handle missing .agent/ directory gracefully in rocket loop
description: In the loop command handler, check for the existence of .agent/ before running preflight checks. Show a friendly error message if it's missing.
acceptanceCriteria: Running rocket loop in a directory without .agent/ shows a friendly error
Error message mentions 'Run rocket init first'

steps.details: At the top of loopCommand, before calling runPreflight: if (!await fs.pathExists(agentDir)) { console.error('No .agent/ directory found. Run rocket init first.'); process.exit(1) }
Create a temp empty directory. Run `rocket loop` in it. Verify the error message appears and process exits with code 1.
